entities.summary: Jean-Claude Merlin is a French astronomer, founder-president of the Burgundy Astronomical Society and a discoverer of minor planets. He was laureate of the Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet Fondation de la Vocation in 1982 and received the Prix Georges Bidault de l'Isle of the Société astronomique de France in 1999.
